_note: Evey's grumbles: what she mutters when something happens. She is a peaceful dog: she never fights, she just has opinions. One line is picked at random per event (never the same twice in a row); she won't speak more than every few seconds, or repeat an event for a while. She speaks plain English, never Trinidad dialect. Every line is a DRAFT until reviewed (tone, how a grumpy old beagle would sound). Events: enemy_near (trouble shows up near Chad), enemy_beaten (Chad cleared it), chad_hurt, chad_faint, idle (Chad stands still a long time), night, swim, eat (Chad eats in front of her), level_up, stay, come, fetch, fetch_nothing, fetched, dig, dig_nothing, dug, sniff (she smells something buried), top_dog (meeting a top dog), fire (Chad stands in fire), weapon_broke (Chad's weapon breaks).
enemy_near: Hrmph. Wake me when it's over.
chad_faint: *sits on you* Comfortable. Take your time.
idle: *flops down* Wake me when we're going somewhere.
*grumble* Standing here is a choice, you know.
night: *sniff* Night air. Smells like trouble and fried fish.
swim: *sputter* I'm a beagle, not a boat.
*paddle paddle* You owe me a towel.
eat: *licks lips* Sharing is caring, you know.
level_up: Hrmph. Don't let it go to your head.
stay: *grunt* Staying. Not because you said so.
come: *sigh* The things I do for you.
fetch: *grumble* Fetch, he says. Like a puppy.
fetch_nothing: *sniff* Nothing to fetch. Like your plan.
dig_nothing: *huff* Nothing buried here but your hopes.
fire: *backs off* Nope. Hot. Bad idea, chief.
*grumble* Who taught you fire? Not me.
